subject: POC workshop: kickoff & load-test window — availability swap?
messages:
From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@finlytics.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@finlytics.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff for POC — hands-on + load test windows

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at FinLytics is excited to get a POC started. We want a hands-on session that includes: a prompt walkthrough, routing configuration review, and a short load test (100 concurrent small prompts) to validate latency under our expected load.

Our initial availability this week is limited. Would any of these windows work for your engineers?
- Thu 9/16, 10:00–12:00 PT (best for product folks)
- Thu 9/16, 15:00–17:00 PT (ops/infra available)
- Fri 9/17, 08:00–10:00 PT (early slot)

We prefer a single 90–120 minute block but can split into an async prep + live validation.

Can you propose a confirmed slot and any prework we should complete? Also, can you send an agenda and a calendar invite?

Thanks,
Claire
Principal Product Manager
FinLytics Solutions

Hi Claire — great to hear and glad the demo was useful.

Thanks for the windows. We can staff engineers for either Thu 9/16 15:00–17:00 PT or Fri 9/17 08:00–10:00 PT. The 9/16 morning slot is hard for us due to an internal release. If you prefer a single block, I recommend Thu 9/16 15:00–17:00 PT so both product and infra can attend.

Proposed agenda (90–120m):
1) 10m intro & goals
2) 30m prompt review + routing demo (prefix/KV cache examples)
3) 30m load test (we'll run a staged ramp to 100 concurrent)
4) 20m results review + next steps

Prework for FinLytics: share 2 representative prompt templates and a short list of expected concurrency profiles (peak qps, typical prompt length). If you'd rather split async, we can send an async runbook and only run the load test live.

I'll tentatively hold Thu 9/16 15:00–17:00 PT and will circulate an agenda + calendar invite once we lock the time. Attaching a draft agenda now.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
